title: Add dedicated SEFLG_HELCTR golden coverage (calc)
description:
SEFLG_HELCTR (heliocentric) support was added to the calc pipeline in swisseph-rs/83 (commit af44cdf) — finish_helctr + HELCTR branches in calc_planet/apparent_planet/calc_moon/apparent_moon, across Moshier + Swiss/JPL. It is currently verified ONLY transitively, via the phenomena golden battery (tests/golden/pheno.rs, 120 cases at eps 1e-9, which exercises HELCTR internally for planets + Moon under MOSEPH/SWIEPH incl. TRUEPOS).

Add a direct golden test that compares `swe_calc(..., SEFLG_HELCTR|SEFLG_XYZ, ...)` (and polar, and with/without J2000/EQUATORIAL/SPEED) against the C library for Sun..Pluto + Moon across the same epochs and the three backends (moshier/sweph/jpl). This gives HELCTR first-class coverage independent of phenomena, and would catch the SPEED path (untested — pheno never sets SEFLG_SPEED on its HELCTR calls) and the JPL backend for the Moon.

Note the literal C quirks documented in the sutra lesson 019f2337 and in docs/codebase-map.md's calc.rs entry: barycentric-vs-heliocentric dt basis for planets, single-pass heliocentric-distance dt for the Moon, original-epoch sun_bary on re-eval. Avoid exact .se1 file-boundary epochs (stateless artifact). BARYCTR remains unimplemented (out of scope).
execution_record:
Added gen_calc_helctr.c (single generator, all 3 backends via a "backend" field), calc_helctr.json (1200 cases), and tests/golden/calc_helctr.rs. Matrix: 3 backends {moshier,sweph,jpl} x Sun..Pluto+Moon (10) x 5 epochs x 8 flag combos ({polar,xyz} x {plain,j2000,equatorial} x {speed,no_speed}, all HELCTR). Positions eps 1e-9, speed eps 1e-7. Epochs reuse the pheno-safe set (avoid sepl_18 boundary 2378496.5). Passed on first run — no fidelity divergence in the previously-untested SPEED path or JPL Moon.

Divergence from plan: the task said "Sun..Pluto+Moon" but heliocentric Sun was never actually implemented in /83 (calc_sun/apparent_sun have no HELCTR branch — only calc_planet/apparent_planet/calc_moon/apparent_moon do). C's swe_calc returns all-zero for heliocentric Sun (Sun relative to itself); Rust was returning the geocentric -observer vector. Fixed with a one-line short-circuit in context.rs calc_inner (returns all-zero for Body::Sun+HELCTR), placed alongside the existing MeanNode/MeanApogee HELCTR-zeros branch. Verified load-bearing by the 120 all-zero Sun rows in the passing test. BARYCTR remains out of scope (still errors). Generator binary is gitignored per tests/c-gen/.gitignore (only .c sources tracked).

messages.author: agent
messages.text: Review (vidhi-review): approve. Verified independently — golden_calc_helctr (1200 cases: Sun..Pluto+Moon × 5 epochs × 8 flag combos × 3 backends) passes, with JPL rows genuinely executing (ephe/de441.eph present, 400 jpl cases incl 40 JPL-Moon). clippy clean. The heliocentric-Sun-zeros short-circuit in calc_inner is correct (Sun relative to itself = origin, invariant under bias/prec/nut) and gives HELCTR first-class coverage independent of phenomena, including the SPEED path pheno never exercised. Minor/non-blocking: the Sun short-circuit returns `flags` as flags_used unmasked, and calc_helctr.rs asserts only output[0..6] (not flags_used), so Sun-HELCTR flags_used is unasserted — astronomically irrelevant.
